message: fix(ai): ground answers in résumé facts + build coherent multi-question sets
post:
When building an AI assistant for job applications, I ran into a common problem: the AI's answers felt generic and disconnected. It wasn't leveraging the candidate's actual background effectively.

The goal for ApplyOS (live at applyos.io) is to help candidates craft compelling application answers. To do this well, the AI needs to be grounded in the provided résumé details and maintain a consistent narrative across multiple questions.

I tackled this by modifying the prompt to explicitly instruct the AI to use *only* the provided background facts. Crucially, I also added a mechanism to pass previously answered questions back into the context for subsequent AI calls. This allows the AI to build upon its prior responses, ensuring a coherent and consistent tone and avoiding repetitive anecdotes.

How do you approach maintaining context and consistency when building AI agents that interact over multiple turns?
